name: The Four Horsemen
notes: Numbers follow docs/research/naxxramas/four-horsemen.md. The room (a 108 yd square, Horsemen in the corners 76 yd apart) is an estimate from the guides' prose. WHAT THE ENGINE CANNOT DO: there is one boss entity, so four live Horsemen with four threat tables, Spirits at the corpses and separate HP pools cannot exist. The fight is modelled as what each group of raiders actually experiences: one 39 s stop at each corner (three Marks), walking clockwise to the next corner, for two full circuits. The boss entity teleports corner to corner each stop (`teleportBossTo` with a `threatWipe`), standing for the Horseman of that corner, with a single HP pool draining across all eight stops: 321 s total (real kills run about 5 to 8 minutes). THE MARKS: real cadence first at 20 s (DBM 21 s), then 12 to 12.9 s (DBM 12.9 s is used). Each Horseman's mark is a stacking debuff (`maxStacks`) with its 75 s duration so the stack counter shows, and the first three stacks' damage (0, then 250, then 1,000: exact values from the wiki, unresistable) is a `radius: 65` `aoe` on the stacks that do damage, cast with the stack debuff. Stack damage is nonlinear (0/250/1,000/3,000/5,000), which `maxStacks`' per-stack `tickDamage` cannot express, so each damaging Mark is its own action. Marks cannot be dropped in the engine except by leaving range, so each stop hard-codes the three stack levels you will really have when the raid rotates on schedule. OVERSTAYING (the actual skill): at +12.9 s after each stop starts (the next Mark tick), anyone not within 24 yd of the new corner's group spot takes `overstay` 3,000 (scored `overstay`): the 4th stack of the Horseman they should have left, 3,000 per the wiki. A real raider who overstays takes even more on the next tick; the engine cannot model the rest of the ladder (5,000, 6,000) because stacks are hard-coded by the stop. The walk between corners (76 yd, about 11 s) must therefore start at the Mark that closes the previous stop. The safe spot in the middle (15 yd around the room's centre, real: 'in front of the platform, out of range of all four') is named for the backup-tank plan but the current rotation never needs it, and marks' `safeSpots` include it so a player who hides there is not hit. TANK ROTATION: real raids use 8 tanks (4 main, 4 backup), each holding about 3 stacks and handing off to a backup Taunt, resisted 16% of the time. The engine has one tank role, so the player tank's loop is 'walk to the next corner, Taunt that Horseman, hold through 3 Marks, repeat': the same loop the real main tanks do on their rotation, without the backups and Taunt resists. Each corner stop is a `threatWipe` so every Horseman's table starts fresh, as it does for that tank. `boss.stationary` keeps him at his corner because tanks walk to the Horseman in this rotation model; in the real fight tanks DRAG Horsemen to the corners on the pull, which happens once, off-screen, inside the 21 s before the first Mark. The ghost tank in other roles follows the same walk. Damage: boss melee is 800 per 2 s swing (one value for all four: classicdb 4,066 to 6,807 before armor; scaled). Righteous Fire (Mograine) is the real 2,160 hit plus 600/s for 8 s on the tank, every 9 s (25% proc per swing, approximated as a fixed cadence). Holy Wrath: the tank takes the first jump (550) as a `debuff`; for everyone else it is a `carried` `stayPut` bomb (`playerChance` 0.3): 1,100 on you (the second jump's damage), raid members within 9.5 yd count as a chain into the raid (`chainOnRaid`), scored only when the raid is spread and you are not on your spot, because the raid formation (`spacing` 10 on this stop) keeps dots 10 yd from you automatically. The real chain doubles per jump; the engine counts jumps as one metric. The chain metric is only scored for ranged and healers: the melee dots hug him at his flanks, so a melee player cannot be 10 yards clear of them; melee still carries and detonates the bomb, unscored. Meteor: a random raider (`playerChance` 0.35) eats 6,000 if they are not inside the 9 yd stack spot at 9 yd from him (`safeSpots` cover; the tank and melee stand inside it too); real Meteor is 12,825 split among everyone within 8 yd, so stacking is the cover here. The tank's share is a 1,300 `debuff`. Void Zones land under random raiders (`playerChance` 0.35, 1.5 s warning, 40 s active, the real 90 s is pointless once the raid has left the corner) and tick 1,500/s (real 3,950 to 4,750, scaled to the bar), and because adds and spirits do not exist, the Spirits-at-corpses mechanic (dead Horsemen keep marking their corner until the fight ends) is unmodelled: the corners never go quiet. Damage is scaled to a 10,000 HP tank, so a tank survives normal play but dies if the healer ignores a spike. A healer who does nothing loses the tank repeatedly: 400 DPS plus Marks and Righteous Fire against a 150/s passive rate. Shield Wall (each Horseman at 50% and 20%, 20 s) is two `shield` windows on the boss's single HP pool, the first at about 44% (the 5th stop's 18 s mark, late so it does not overlap the walk and the rotate note) and the second at about 20% (the real ones are four independent ones per Horseman at 50% and 20%); DPS must stop attacking for 20 s (`attacksIntoShield` scored), standing in for the real instruction to swap to another Horseman, which the engine cannot show because only one boss exists. Enrage (100 Marks, about 20 min) is not reached and not modelled; Mark radius and cadence open questions are in the research file. Spirit HP (6,920 and 937) and melee are unused. Disarms are not modelled.

safeCenter.label: Safe spot (stands for the area in front of the platform)

boss.looseHint: New corner. Walk over and Taunt.

tank.label: Main tank
tank.description: You rotate with your group: three stacks on one Horseman, then walk to the next corner and Taunt the next one. The fourth stack is 3,000 and the fifth is 5,000, so the walk starts on the third Mark, every time.

melee.label: Melee DPS
melee.description: Rotate clockwise with your group. Korth'azz: stack on his group for Meteor. Zeliek: spread 10 yards or Holy Wrath chains. Blaumeux: move out of Void Zones. Mograine: stay on him. Shield Wall at 50% and 20%: stop.

ranged.label: Ranged DPS
ranged.description: Rotate with your group, three Marks per corner, and stay inside 30 yards of your Horseman. Same rules: stack on Korth'azz, spread on Zeliek, dodge Blaumeux's zones.

healer.label: Healer
healer.description: Move with your group and keep the tank up: the tank walks between Horsemen and takes Righteous Fire on Mograine. Marks hit the tank too, and they hit you. Never take the fourth Mark yourself.

taunt.label: Taunt
taunt.tip: Taunt forces the boss onto you for a few seconds and puts you on top of the threat table. Press it the moment the boss turns on the raid, never while it is already on you.

attack.label: Attack
attack.tip: Attacks generate threat. Stop when the threat bar turns red so the boss stays on the tank.

heal.label: Heal the tank
heal.tip: A large heal for the tank. Time it to land with the incoming damage.

markStack_k.label: Mark of Korth'azz
markStack_k.tip: One stack does nothing. The next stacks cost 250, then 1,000, then 3,000. Rotate before the fourth.

markHit_k_3.label: Mark of Korth'azz: 1,000
markHit_k_3.tip: The third stack costs 1,000. Your next Mark here costs 3,000: be walking to the next corner.

arrival_k.label: First Mark of the stop
arrival_k.tip: The Mark lands wherever you are standing.

overstay_k.label: You overstayed
overstay_k.tip: You were too far from this corner's group when the Mark landed: 3,000 for the old Horseman's fourth stack.

arrive_k.label: Rotate to Korth'azz
arrive_k.tip: New corner, new Horseman, a fresh threat table. Be walking the moment the third Mark lands.

meteor.label: Meteor
meteor.tip: Meteor splits among everyone within 8 yards. Stand in the group or eat it alone.

meteorTank.label: Meteor: the tank's share
meteorTank.tip: The tank takes a share every time.

holyWrath.label: Holy Wrath
holyWrath.tip: It chains to anyone within 10 yards of you and doubles each jump. Hold your spot in the formation.

voidZone.label: Void Zone
voidZone.tip: A black circle. Step out before it opens; Consumption hurts every second.

righteousFireHit.label: Righteous Fire
righteousFireHit.tip: Mograine procs 2,160 Fire on his target, then 600 a second for 8 seconds. It is not dispellable.

shieldWall.label: Shield Wall
shieldWall.toast: Shield Wall: stop attacking for 20 seconds
shieldWall.tip: -75% damage taken for 20 seconds. Stop hitting this one until it ends.

expectations.label: Pull him to Korth'azz's corner before the first Mark
expectations.tip: You have 20 seconds. Drag him to the corner, stack with your group.

expectations.label: Be at Korth'azz when the Marks land
expectations.tip: Rotate clockwise on the third Mark of the last corner. Marks do not care that you were walking.

threatLostCount.label: Times the boss turned on the raid

aggroPulls.label: Times you pulled aggro
aggroPulls.tip: Stop attacking when the threat bar turns red.

attacksInRed.label: Attacks in the red band
attacksInRed.tip: Stop attacking in the red band so the tank can regain a threat lead.

earlyAttacks.label: Attacks before the tank had the boss
earlyAttacks.tip: Give the tank a few seconds after the pull.

dpsIdle.label: Seconds not attacking when you could
dpsIdle.tip: Keep attacking when it's safe. Stop if the threat bar turns red or the boss leaves the tank.

playerInHazard.label: Seconds standing in something bad
playerInHazard.tip: Move out of the ground effect before attacking again.

tankLowSeconds.label: Seconds with the tank under half
tankLowSeconds.tip: Top the tank up before the spike lands, not after.

overheals.label: Wasted heals
overheals.tip: Avoid healing the tank at full health. Save the heal for incoming damage.

meteorsAlone.label: Meteors you took alone
meteorsAlone.tip: Stand in the stack on Korth'azz.

chainOnRaid.label: Holy Wrath chained into the raid
chainOnRaid.tip: Hold your spot on Zeliek: 10 yards from everyone.

attacksIntoShield.label: Attacks into Shield Wall
attacksIntoShield.tip: Stop for 20 seconds when he Shield Walls.

cues.notes: Tank: walk to each corner and Taunt. DPS: be attacking again soon after each corner. Healer: Righteous Fire on Mograine.

list.label: Heal the tank when they drop low
list.tip: The tank is below half health and a big hit is coming. Heal now.

list.label: Taunt Korth'azz
list.tip: Finish the walk and Taunt him.

list.label: Taunt Mograine
list.tip: Finish the walk and Taunt him.

list.label: Taunt Zeliek
list.tip: Finish the walk and Taunt him.

list.label: Taunt Blaumeux
list.tip: Finish the walk and Taunt him.

list.label: Back on Korth'azz
list.tip: Get to the new corner and start hitting.

list.label: Back on Mograine
list.tip: Get to the new corner and start hitting.

list.label: Back on Zeliek
list.tip: Get to the new corner and start hitting.

list.label: Back on Blaumeux
list.tip: Get to the new corner and start hitting.

list.label: Heal through Righteous Fire
list.tip: Hit, then DoT. Pre-heal the tank for the next one.

drills.name: Walk and Taunt
drills.description: A new corner opens and his table is empty. Walk there and Taunt within 12 seconds, then hold him through the Marks.

drills.name: Dance out of Void Zones
drills.description: A Void Zone drops under someone every 8 seconds. Step out before it opens, then keep attacking.

drills.name: Heal Righteous Fire
drills.description: Mograine procs Righteous Fire every 7 seconds. Heal the 2,160 and the 8 seconds of burn.

limitations: The four Horsemen are represented by one boss. Marks and tank rotations do not come from four independent positions.
